notes: Streets printed without a suffix (BAYMILLER, FINDLAY, WERNER, LIVINGSTON, POPLAR, OLIVER, LINN, BARTON) recorded as '... Street'. Scan is rotated slightly clockwise (east-west streets drop ~40 px across the sheet). Livingston jogs at Baymiller: west leg (to sheet 205) centreline y~2480, east leg y~2577. Ashton Alley shows on this sheet only east of Baymiller (west block line drawn unbroken), so recorded as T at Baymiller; it ends at Werner. Barton Street enters from the south (Volume 1 area) and Ts into West Liberty. Werner runs Findlay to Livingston only.
